$comment: CN/V20261019: CN-advanced-3.1.0, II.E-28 and FAQ1/2, one-based PDF page 68. This only replaces the Burn counter count, not Burn application, prevention or recovery.

counterCount.description: A count of ten-damage counters, NOT damage points or physical cards. Bound ensures count * 10 is exact.

burnCounters.description: Continuously changes Burn counters for matching Pokémon. The host first filters unavailable/suppressed sources and scope/position/type predicates. Multiple applicable counts use their maximum once; only no applicable change uses the ordinary default of two.

change.description: An already applicable, independently reviewed continuous descriptor projected to aggregation input. IDs are engine descriptor identities, not necessarily card-definition IDs.

changes.description: Empty means default two. Nonempty means maximum of just the supplied replacement counts, even if all are zero or one. Runtime additionally requires unique change IDs.
